title: Validate readinto buffers before consuming input and count bytes, not elements
applies_when: A Python file-like wrapper implements readinto with len(buffer), reads first, or assigns bytes directly to an array or typed/multidimensional memoryview.
lesson: Resolve the actual buffer protocol before reading: a typed view's len counts elements (or its first dimension), not byte capacity, and direct slice assignment can reject bytes after the stream position has already advanced. For a byte-oriented readinto contract, acquire a new memoryview, reject read-only destinations and form a writable C-contiguous byte view before consuming input. Read at most that byte view's length and return bytes transferred. Release only temporary views, not the caller's object. Pair bytearray, integer array, typed/shaped/sliced memoryview and empty-buffer cases with native FileIO; also test read-only, noncontiguous and non-buffer inputs at interior positions and EOF, asserting failure leaves the position and remaining input unchanged. Ordinary bytearray-only tests miss the typed-length and late-validation failures.
avoid_when: A protocol that explicitly supports strided scatter or element-oriented transfers needs its own contract; nbytes alone does not establish contiguity or writability. This change is not zero-copy I/O, thread-safety, a Python-wide exception-order guarantee or performance evidence. JuiceFS evidence covers native Linux Python3.12.13 with current-source Go1.25.10 libjfs, SQLite and local object storage; it does not cover the full Redis/MySQL/TiKV CI matrix. The submitted PR and retrieval check do not prove maintainer acceptance, Scout conversion improvement or prospective evidence-selection utility.

evidence.note: The byte-oriented API requires a writable bytes-like destination and returns bytes read. The documentation is an API contract, not a measurement of a third-party wrapper.
A byte cast creates a new view without copying the buffer and is restricted by contiguity; the adjacent nbytes examples distinguish byte capacity from element count and multidimensional len.
Current-main reproduction: typed arrays fail after consuming input; invalid destinations can advance position or be accepted at EOF. No mock libjfs was used.

Two-file repair with native before/after FileTests, 330 raw/buffered FileIO differential cases and 64 existing stream regressions. Source/test bytes were rechecked from the committed Git blobs. Submitted Ready, not an accepted merge or service-backend matrix result.
